solution: For $|x|<1$, $\ln(1+x)=\sum_{k=1}^{\infty}(-1)^{k+1}\dfrac{x^{k}}{k}$. Dividing by $x$ and integrating term by term from $0$ to $1$ gives $\sum_{k=1}^{\infty}\dfrac{(-1)^{k+1}}{k^{2}}=1-\tfrac14+\tfrac19-\tfrac1{16}+\cdots$. This alternating series equals $\eta(2)=(1-2^{1-2})\zeta(2)=\tfrac12\cdot\tfrac{\pi^{2}}{6}=\tfrac{\pi^{2}}{12}$.
